contract: assert the command name comes from the attribute on the struct while every argument id comes from a field and its attribute
assert help and version are absent from the Command until Command::build injects them, and that parsing performs that build for you
assert the clap 3 #[clap(...)] spelling still compiles under clap 4, naming the command on the struct and declaring the argument on a field
assert a minimal invocation fills default_value_t and leaves an Option<T> option as None
assert dropping the program name from try_parse_from makes the first real argument the program name in the usage line and reports a missing required argument
assert -o value, --output value, --output=value and the attached -ovalue all set the same option
assert ArgAction::Count turns -vvv into 3 and -v -v into 2
assert -V is the version flag while -v stays the verbose counter
assert ValueEnum renders variants in kebab-case and that pretty_json, PrettyJson and JSON are ErrorKind::InvalidValue
assert an unknown flag is ErrorKind::UnknownArgument and that the rendered error carries the tip naming the real --output
assert a missing required positional is ErrorKind::MissingRequiredArgument
assert both real errors exit 2 and go to stderr
assert --help and -h are ErrorKind::DisplayHelp with exit code 0 on stdout, not a parse failure
assert the rendered help shows the default value and the possible values
assert --version is ErrorKind::DisplayVersion carrying the version from the command attribute
case.goal: Define and test a clap 4 derive CLI across the #[clap] to #[command] and #[arg] attribute split, checking outcomes with try_parse_from and ErrorKind instead of a process
